proofs_written_and_checked.status: Ungraded thick classification is a primary-source input; the conservative forgetful functor, regrading, and compact-localization argument are written and checked.
Direct Koszul/Clifford derivation, internal/cohomological grading and root-of-unity norm checked. N=5 Euler vector is (-9,9,0).

Fixed finite-object localization and generic generation proved under existing local proper/window input L and actual completed functor CF. Does not infer effectivity from an arbitrary compatible Artin tower.

Compact generic kernel descends to a finite algebraic extension by filtered-colimit descent, perfect-cone support, and a closed point. Explicit lambda=1 target also depends on existing D. No explicit kernel matrices or extension degree supplied.
